verdict.rationale: mParticle documents several programmatic surfaces: an Events API with an OpenAPI spec, a Platform API Audiences page, a Warehouse Sync API and a versioned Data Subject Request API. Some workflows are documented only as UI steps, such as connecting an audience through Data Platform > Setup > Directory. Nothing shows that everything doable in the UI is also doable via the API. Missing for 10: any documented UI/API parity statement, evidence that configuration tasks like connections, data quality rules and integrations are fully API-addressable, machine-readable specs beyond the Events API, and independent corroboration of API coverage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
